svg.text: PR #2439 · Read the session secret from SESSION_SECRET_FILE
The cookie + launcher JWT secret could only come from an env var, with a silent ephemeral fallback.
Now a read-only file can supply the same bytes, and any file problem fails startup instead.
BEFORE
AFTER
env::var("SESSION_SECRET")
The only source. Deploys must place the secret in the
container environment (env_file, compose, inspect output).
Missing -> Key::generate(), warn only
A lost secret still boots: every restart logs out all
browsers and invalidates every launcher JWT.
resolve_session_secret(env, SESSION_SECRET_FILE)
File: strip one "\n" or "\r\n", require UTF-8, non-empty.
Same bytes as the env var -> same cookie_key and jwt_secret.
read_session_secret_file: checks on the open fd
Regular file, owner root or backend uid, mode & 0o022 == 0,
at most 4096 bytes. Root 0444 and uid-1001 0400 both pass.
Fail closed: errors abort boot
Both set, empty path, missing/empty/unsafe file: no fallback.
Logs source = env | file | ephemeral; never value or length.
Scope: env-only and unset behaviour unchanged (unset still boots ephemeral). Cookie and JWT keys still share one secret; no HKDF split.
